depth_source: Predicted from training RGB only; robust scale/shift aligned to RGB-triangulated training observations
normals_source: Finite differences of smoothed predicted z-depth, camera-facing, transformed to the existing world frame
scope: Priors and confidences are estimates, not ground truth. Camera poses were estimated offline from all RGB views.
alignment_metric_scope: Residual on training correspondences used by the robust fit, not independent depth accuracy
